description.en:
Number of population by statistical units. The statistical variables in the data are:

- total population (vaesto),
- share of the total population (vaesto_p)
- number of men (miehet)
- mens share of the population in an area (miehet_p)
- number of women (naiset)
- womens share (naiset_p)
- those aged under 15: number (ika_0_14) and share (ika_0_14p),
- those aged 15 to 64: number (ika_15_64) and share (ika_15_64p),
- aged 65 or over: number (ika_65_)and share (ika_65_p).

The data is suitable for the examination of population distribution and making various regional analyses.

From Statistics Finland WMS and WFS service also other statistical units are available: sub-regional units, regions, major regions, Regional State Administrative Agencies (AVI) and Centres for Economic Development, Transport and the Environment (ELY).

The data format has been changed to Shape at CSC. 

Coordinate Reference System: ETRS89 / ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067)
